Package cafe94.system.model.order

Class Order

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.model.order.Order
Direct Known Subclasses:
DeliveryOrder, EatInOrder, TakeawayOrder
public abstract class Order extends Object
Abstract superclass representing a general order in the Cafe94 system.

This class defines common properties and behaviors for all types of orders, including Eat-In, Takeaway, and Delivery orders. Each subclass must provide its specific OrderType and override the serialization method if needed.
